name: 0000_new_whizzer.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE `nexora_ai_runs` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`owner` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE `nexora_records` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`owner` text NOT NULL,
	`kind` text NOT NULL,
	`payload` text NOT NULL,
	`dedupe` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `nexora_owner_dedupe` ON `nexora_records` (`owner`,`dedupe`)

name: 0001_cultured_thunderbolt.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE `nexora_agent_alerts` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`owner` text NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`body` text NOT NULL,
	`target_id` text,
	`seen` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE `nexora_agent_controls` (
	`owner` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`config` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE `nexora_agent_jobs` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`owner` text NOT NULL,
	`type` text NOT NULL,
	`target_id` text,
	`state` text NOT NULL,
	`input` text NOT NULL,
	`output` text,
	`reason` text,
	`dedupe` text NOT NULL,
	`lease` text,
	`lease_until` text,
	`attempts` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `nexora_job_dedupe` ON `nexora_agent_jobs` (`owner`,`dedupe`)

name: 0002_bright_madame_masque.sql
statements:

	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`encrypted_token` text NOT NULL,
	`scopes` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	`connected_at` text NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE `nexora_linkedin_posts` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`owner` text NOT NULL,
	`body` text NOT NULL,
	`state` text NOT NULL,
	`scheduled_at` text NOT NULL,
	`subject` text NOT NULL,
	`remote_id` text,
	`reason` text,
	`started_at` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE `nexora_linkedin_states` (
	`hash` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`owner` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	`redirect_uri` text NOT NULL,
	`scopes` text NOT NULL
)

name: 0003_freezing_bullseye.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE `nexora_intake_links` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`owner` text NOT NULL,
	`lead_id` text NOT NULL,
	`token_hash` text NOT NULL,
	`state` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	`submission_id` text,
	`submission_hash` text,
	`submission` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`submitted_at` text
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `nexora_intake_token` ON `nexora_intake_links` (`token_hash`)

name: 0004_sloppy_human_fly.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE `nexora_reviews` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`owner` text NOT NULL,
	`kind` text NOT NULL,
	`target_id` text NOT NULL,
	`section` text,
	`fingerprint` text NOT NULL,
	`payload` text NOT NULL,
	`state` text NOT NULL,
	`scheduled_at` text,
	`post_id` text,
	`subject` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `nexora_review_snapshot` ON `nexora_reviews` (`owner`,`fingerprint`)

name: 0005_perfect_machine_man.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE `nexora_network_accounts` (
	`owner` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`api_base` text NOT NULL,
	`encrypted_key` text NOT NULL,
	`account_id` text,
	`identifier` text,
	`name` text,
	`state` text NOT NULL,
	`execution_lease` text,
	`execution_until` text,
	`config` text NOT NULL,
	`sync_cursor` text,
	`last_sync_at` text,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `nexora_network_account_unique` ON `nexora_network_accounts` (`account_id`)

CREATE TABLE `nexora_network_actions` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`owner` text NOT NULL,
	`account_id` text NOT NULL,
	`kind` text NOT NULL,
	`target_id` text NOT NULL,
	`fingerprint` text NOT NULL,
	`payload` text NOT NULL,
	`state` text NOT NULL,
	`receipt` text,
	`reason` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `nexora_network_action_dedupe` ON `nexora_network_actions` (`owner`,`fingerprint`)

CREATE TABLE `nexora_network_auth` (
	`token_hash` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`owner` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` text NOT NULL,
	`state` text NOT NULL
)

name: 0006_n8n_runner.sql
statements:
CREATE TABLE `nexora_n8n` (
 `owner` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
 `token_hash` text NOT NULL,
 `enabled` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 `allow_model` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 `expires_at` text NOT NULL,
 `last_seen_at` text,
 `updated_at` text NOT NULL
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `nexora_n8n_token` ON `nexora_n8n` (`token_hash`)

name: 0007_n8n_account_scopes.sql
statements: ALTER TABLE `nexora_n8n` ADD `allow_posting` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE `nexora_n8n` ADD `allow_network` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
